verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Fathom can be deployed on user infrastructure. The API, SDKs, webhooks and MCP server all point at Fathom's hosted service (e.g. api.fathom.ai/mcp), which is the opposite of self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
